# harness_platform_sso_oauth (Data Source)

Data source for retrieving the OAuth SSO configuration of a Harness account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "harness_platform_sso_oauth" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `allowed_providers` (Set of String) OAuth providers users are allowed to sign in with.
- `filter` (String) Filter applied to the available OAuth providers.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
